name: Quantic
author: Francesc Leveque
description: Your next dividend in the Omarchy bar, and the next two weeks in a panel, from Quantic Finance through quantic-cli.

barWidget.description: Your next ex-dividend date or payment; the panel has the next 14 days and this month's income.

schema.label: Portfolio
schema.description: One portfolio, by name or slug. Empty: all of them, and your radar.

schema.label: Show amounts in the bar
schema.description: The bar is visible when you share your screen. The panel always shows amounts.

schema.label: quantic command
schema.description: The quantic binary: a name on PATH, or a full path such as ~/go/bin/quantic.
